summary: Faraday Future filed an 8-K to disclose a Supplemental Agreement with a previously announced partner regarding development of an FF Super One battery electric vehicle. The agreement upgrades the vehicle to an 800V architecture, pauses the original 400V project, and sets phased delivery timelines of 6-9 months (first phase) up to 24-28 months (third phase) once funding is secured. No financial terms, price per share, or premium are stated. The filing is a routine contractual update that does not fit into any special-situation category. The board recommendation, advisors, and risk-arb spread are absent. Watch for funding milestones.
